edgeCasesMissed: Browser E2E proves bounded burst and sustained typing calls plus the visible typing transition, but does not keep the same draft session open long enough to assert the complete typing-to-idle-to-quiet lifecycle after sustained input.
topFinding: No exploitable HIGH or CRITICAL defect remains: presence registration now requires a syntactically valid live SSE session owned by the authenticated tenant/user, actor-session buckets are pruned on close and expiry, and browser connection generations prevent stale close callbacks or cancelled limiters from affecting a replacement connection.

impact.rationale: Static adversarial inspection and passing pure browser timing/ownership tests support the retry fixes. Server network tests could not bind an ephemeral port in the restricted validation environment (EADDRINUSE on port 0), which is an execution-environment limitation rather than an observed product failure.
